images.detail_th: ภาพจำลอง JUNIOR WORLD เป็นห้องกิจกรรมเด็กขนาดใหญ่ในโทนสีขาวและแสงสีน้ำเงินแบบล้ำอนาคต ด้านซ้ายเป็นบ่อบอลทรงโค้งบรรจุลูกบอลสีขาว ฟ้าอ่อน และน้ำเงิน มีบันไดเตี้ยพร้อมไฟซ่อนนำขึ้นสู่บ่อ เหนือบ่อเป็นจอหรือภาพติดผนังขนาดใหญ่แสดงโลกใต้ทะเลสีสด มีปลาหมึก ปลา แมงกะพรุน ปะการัง และฟองอากาศ เด็กสองคนกำลังเล่นในบ่อบอล เพดานพิมพ์ภาพกาแล็กซีและท้องฟ้าดาว มีหุ่นนักบินอวกาศ ดาวเคราะห์ และลูกทรงกลมห้อยอยู่หลายตำแหน่ง ตอนกลางและด้านขวามีเด็กหลายคนทำกิจกรรม มีโต๊ะเล่นเกมแบบจอสัมผัสทรงกลมพร้อมสตูลนุ่ม จอภาพติดผนังสองจอพร้อมที่นั่ง และชั้นวางหนังสือหรือของเล่น ผนังกระจกด้านหลังแต่งด้วยต้นไม้และพื้นที่นั่งพัก ด้านขวาบนของหน้าแสดงผังย่อ ENTRANCE FLOOR โดยเน้นตำแหน่ง JUNIOR WORLD ทางซ้ายของผัง
images.detail_en: The JUNIOR WORLD rendering shows a large children's activity room finished in white with futuristic blue lighting. On the left, a curved ball pit contains white, pale-blue, and dark-blue balls, reached by low steps with concealed lighting. A large display or mural above the pit depicts a vivid underwater world with octopuses, fish, jellyfish, coral, and bubbles. Two children play in the ball pit. The ceiling is printed with a galaxy and star field, with several suspended astronauts, planets, and spherical celestial objects. Numerous children use the central and right-hand activity areas. These include a round interactive touch-screen game table with soft stools, two wall-mounted displays with seats, and shelves holding books or toys. A glazed rear area is decorated with plants and seating. At upper right, a small ENTRANCE FLOOR plan highlights JUNIOR WORLD on the left side of the plan.

images.detail_en: The ring-shaped BASEMENT plan shows numerous parking bays around all four outer sides. The individual bay numbers are too small to read reliably. WITH EV CHARGER is printed along the lower-left parking row. A large vehicle circulation area fills the ring, with lift cores, stairs, service rooms, and ramps distributed around the plan. A dark-blue amenity group occupies the upper center. It contains HIMALAYAN SALT SAUNA, ICE BATH, FLOATING SWING SAUNA, CRYTAL STONE SAUNA, and HYDRO THERAPY CAPSULE. Below them are MEDIA ROOM, OFFICE / RECEPTION, the long AQUA CINEMA space furnished with clustered seating, and JOURNEY TO MARS at right, where a winding route passes rock-like elements. The white plan contrasts with a blurred blue-gray background, while cyan lettering emphasizes the experience areas.

images.detail_en: This enlarged BASEMENT plan labels AQUA CINEMA at the top and connects the label to the main central area with a leader line. AQUA CINEMA is a long, curved-edge space resembling a pool or underwater landscape, with circular seats and free-form seating clusters arranged along its upper edge. A spiral stair is at lower left, and SCREEN PROJECTOR is marked along the lower edge. Across the top, HIMALAYAN SALT SAUNA, ICE BATH, FLOATING SWING SAUNA, CRYTAL STONE SAUNA, and HYDRO THERAPY CAPSULE run from left to right; CRYTAL is transcribed exactly as printed. To the right of the capsule are an accessible restroom, male and female restrooms, a service room, a stair core, and a JACUZZI area containing two circular tubs. JOURNEY TO MARS occupies the lower right with a free-form route, six reclining chairs, and terrain-like forms suggestive of Mars. MDB/PUMP and OFFICE & CONTROL are at lower left. The plan uses a dark-blue field, white linework, and cyan lettering for key area names.

images.detail_en: The AQUA CINEMA rendering depicts a long indoor swimming pool in deep blue tones. A large cinema screen on the left wall shows a moon over the sea, with the screen and lighting reflected across the water. Long guide lines and underwater lights run along the pool floor. On the right, several curved floor tiers use concealed blue and white light strips. Reclining loungers line the pool edge, with round lounge sofas behind them. Long ceiling fins radiate from the center with blue lighting, transitioning to warm-white illumination over the right-hand side. Round columns, trees, and glazing open this side toward the exterior. A white spiral stair or sculptural feature stands at the far end of the pool. At upper right, a small BASEMENT plan highlights AQUA CINEMA in the center.

Nested rings glow white and blue around a star field, with an orange planetary landscape at the distant opening. Ceiling fins and blue light strips radiate outward from the tunnel above the pool. On the right, a cinema screen shows a moon above the sea and reflects across the water. The left side has curved floor tiers with concealed lighting, several loungers, sofas, decorative trees, round columns, and floor lanterns. Warm-white light in the lounge area contrasts with the pool's deep blue. At upper right, a small BASEMENT plan highlights AQUA CINEMA.

A winding blue luminous water-like path or floor runs through the center, depicting jellyfish, fish, and stars. Near its far end is a round shallow-pool-like area. Reclining chairs and small rock gardens line the route. The circular tunnel opening frames an orange Martian landscape with mountains, rocks, and two sun- or planet-like bodies in the sky. At upper right, a small BASEMENT plan highlights JOURNEY TO MARS in the right-hand corner.

images.detail_en: The bird's-eye plan shows the rooftops of all six buildings around the development. Each roof has flowing curved cream paths interwoven with trees, shrubs, and flower beds, plus pathway lighting and perimeter guardrails. Building E has a long winding path, seating areas, two circular pools, and a narrow water strip. Building F has a wave-shaped path, a long garden, water along the edge, and a seating terrace. Building A has a wave-shaped path and long garden with water strips at both ends. Building B has an upper seating terrace and a winding path following the building's angled footprint. Building D has a large leisure terrace with four circular pools, sun loungers, tables and chairs, and a water strip. Building C has five circular pools, sun loungers, tables and chairs, a curved path, gardens, and a water strip. Every building also contains gray service-roof areas and central-core structures.
